answer_2.quote: We perform all baseline methods on our SpatialMQA benchmark. ... we report four metrics: precision (P), recall (R), F1, and accuracy (Acc).

answer_4.quote: In other methods, when humans answer questions without images, the accuracy is 24.40% ... we randomly select 500 samples from SpatialMQA and invite three college students (different from the annotation team) to answer the questions. The final answer is determined by majority voting.
answer_4.guideline: Three annotators answer each sample; majority voting determines the final answer.
